zh.thesis: 多项政策都因意想不到的后果而失效，包括 MAGA 运动、劳动份额下降、高技能移民、AI 生产力等。
paragraphs: MAGA 影响力下滑，因其未建立持久机构，特朗普的政策失误加剧流失。劳动份额下降部分源于税制导致的收入归类变化，而非真实减少。
OPT 扩展研究显示，高技能移民增加 1% 企业、0.5% 本土就业和 1% 工资，说明其互补而非替代。AI 虽提升效率，但尚未在行业层面体现，投资热潮仅是资本利用率提高。
此外，毒品「减害」政策虽帮助成瘾者，却污染了城市环境，蓝色城市正悄然收紧。这些例子警示，政策需考虑连锁反应。

en.thesis: Several policies have failed due to unintended consequences, including the MAGA movement, declining labor share, high-skilled immigration, and AI productivity.
paragraphs: The MAGA movement's influence has declined because it did not build lasting institutions, and Trump's policy missteps have accelerated the erosion. The decline in labor share is partly due to tax-induced changes in income classification, not a real decrease.

OPT extension studies show that a 1% increase in high-skilled immigrants boosts firms by 1%, native employment by 0.5%, and wages by 1%, indicating they complement rather than substitute native workers. AI, while improving efficiency, has not yet shown industry-level gains; the investment boom merely reflects higher capital utilization.

Additionally, drug 'harm reduction' policies, while helping addicts, have polluted urban environments, and blue cities are quietly tightening their policies. These examples warn that policies must consider ripple effects.

articles.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
articles.author: florianherrengt

zh.thesis: AI 让平庸工程师能以更快速度制造技术债，从而加剧软件行业薪资两极分化。
paragraphs: 过去，糟糕的工程决策有速度上限；如今，AI 代理让开发者一天生成两万行代码，但没人真正理解其逻辑。作者描绘了这样的场景：工程师依赖 Claude 对话解释设计决策，代码库迅速变得无人能懂。
技术债一旦产生便极难逆转——添加数据库表只需十分钟，迁移却需数月。在团队修复旧债时，新债以更快速度涌入，导致项目最终失控。
作者断言，未来薪资差距将拉大：能评估 AI 输出的优秀工程师更值钱，而只靠提示词混日子的「vibe coder」将失业。这种分化可能蔓延至所有知识工作。

en.thesis: AI lets mediocre engineers generate tech debt at a faster rate, widening pay disparities in the software industry.
paragraphs: In the past, bad engineering decisions had a speed limit; now, AI agents let developers write twenty thousand lines of code a day, with no one really understanding the logic. The author paints a scenario where engineers rely on Claude conversations to explain design decisions, and the codebase quickly becomes incomprehensible.

Tech debt, once created, is extremely hard to reverse—adding a database table takes ten minutes, but migrating takes months. While teams fix old debt, new debt floods in faster, causing projects to spiral out of control.

The author asserts that future pay gaps will widen: excellent engineers who can evaluate AI output will be more valuable, while 'vibe coders' who just rely on prompts will lose their jobs. This divide could spread to all knowledge work.

articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed can win moderate voters
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 密歇根州民主党参议员候选人 El-Sayed 虽属左翼，但有望凭借务实立场赢得温和选民。
paragraphs: 作者虽曾担忧 El-Sayed 过于左倾，但认为他具备独特优势。他出身移民家庭，兼具传统价值观与进步立场，能在以色列、医疗等议题上展现温和面向。
例如，他主张「美国优先」而非「巴勒斯坦优先」，反对无条件军援，强调解决国内问题。在医改上，他应推动「全民医保」作为愿景而非具体法案，以团结党内。
若他能与主流民主党人合作，展现大帐篷姿态，则有望扭转外界对其极端化的担忧，赢得大选。

en.thesis: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate El-Sayed, despite being left-leaning, has the potential to win moderate voters through his pragmatic stance.
paragraphs: The author, though initially worried El-Sayed was too left-wing, believes he has unique advantages. Coming from an immigrant family, he combines traditional values with progressive positions, allowing him to show a moderate side on issues like Israel and healthcare.

For example, he advocates 'America First' rather than 'Palestine First', opposes unconditional military aid, and emphasizes solving domestic issues. On healthcare reform, he should promote 'Medicare for All' as a vision rather than a specific bill to unite the party.
If he can cooperate with mainstream Democrats and project a big-tent posture, he may overturn concerns about his extremism and win the general election.

zh.thesis: Base Power 以 130 亿美元估值融资 10 亿，作者论证其垂直整合与「能力大炮」战略可使其成为全球最大能源公司。
paragraphs: Base Power 成立不足三年，估值已达 130 亿美元，为全球第二大能源初创。公司以住宅电池切入得州电网瓶颈，自产 Gen 3 电池以降低成本并掌控技术栈。
作者认为，Base 通过垂直整合和规模化部署赢得「高地」，再以积累的制造、品牌、政策等能力向外拓展。取消 Gen 2 直接自研，虽付罚金，但加速了能力建设。
若此模式成立，Base 有望从第 182 位跃升至能源巨头前列。但作者也承认，赢得高地只是开始，规模化执行仍是巨大挑战。

en.thesis: Base Power, valued at $13 billion after a $1 billion raise, could become the world's largest energy company through vertical integration and a 'capability cannon' strategy.
paragraphs: Base Power, founded less than three years ago, is already valued at $13 billion, making it the second-largest energy startup globally. The company targets Texas's grid bottlenecks with residential batteries, manufacturing its own Gen 3 batteries to cut costs and own the tech stack.

The author argues that Base, by vertically integrating and scaling deployments, wins the 'high ground,' then uses accumulated manufacturing, branding, policy, and other capabilities to expand outward. Canceling Gen 2 to build its own, despite a penalty, accelerated capability building.

If this model works, Base could jump from 182nd place to the top ranks of energy giants. But the author admits that winning the high ground is only the beginning; scaling execution remains a huge challenge.

articles.title: Why tiny JPEGs look different in Chrome
articles.author: gutechh

zh.thesis: Chrome 渲染小尺寸 JPEG 时看起来更粗，源于它用部分 IDCT 解码跳过高频细节，而非显示 bug。
paragraphs: 作者发现同一图标在 Firefox 与 Chrome 下略有差异，最终追查到一个解码优化：Chrome 用的 Skia 通过 libjpeg-turbo 实现部分 IDCT 缩放。
具体来说，JPEG 将图像拆成 8×8 块并转换为频率域，高频对应细节。缩小时，Chrome 会按分母为 8 的分数解码，只保留低频分量，再进一步缩放，因此丢失了边缘柔和与渐变。
结果是图标在小尺寸下显得更粗。不过作者也承认，缩放算法本身同样影响外观；真正的教训是 JPEG 为照片而设，图标这类应改用 SVG。

en.thesis: Chrome's downscaled JPEGs look grainier because of a decoding optimization that skips high-frequency detail, not a display bug.
paragraphs: The author noticed that the same icon looked slightly different in Firefox and Chrome, and traced the discrepancy to a decoding optimization: Chrome's Skia, via libjpeg-turbo, uses partial IDCT scaling.

Specifically, JPEG splits an image into 8x8 blocks and converts them to the frequency domain, where high frequencies correspond to detail. When scaling down, Chrome decodes at a fraction of the original size, keeping only the low-frequency components and then scaling further, which loses edge softness and gradients.

The result is that icons look bolder at small sizes. The author concedes, though, that the scaling algorithm itself also affects appearance; the real lesson is that JPEG is meant for photos, and icons should use SVG instead.

articles.title: I can't believe how good this AI coding model is, and it isn't from OpenAI or Anthropic
articles.author: Parth Shah

zh.thesis: Grok 4.5 在 Cursor 中的编码体验虽非最强，但极高的 token 效率使其成为实用之选。
paragraphs: 作者原以为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的模型已无对手，但将 Grok 4.5 载入 Cursor 后，发现其完成一个完整网站仅耗约 4 万 token，速度与成本优势惊人。
具体来说，Grok 4.5 能快速理解需求并直接执行，不浪费上下文在无关文件上。不过，复杂任务仍不如 Claude Code 等模型，作者期待 Grok 4.6 改进。
这显示模型竞争已从单纯智商转向效率，对开发者的日常迭代影响重大。

en.thesis: Grok 4.5's coding experience in Cursor is not the strongest, but its exceptional token efficiency makes it a practical choice.
paragraphs: The author initially thought OpenAI and Anthropic models were unbeatable, but after loading Grok 4.5 into Cursor, they found it completed an entire website using only about 40,000 tokens, with impressive speed and cost advantages.

Specifically, Grok 4.5 quickly understands requirements and executes directly without wasting context on unrelated files. However, for complex tasks, it still falls short of models like Claude Code, and the author looks forward to improvements in Grok 4.6.
This shows that the competition among models has shifted from sheer intelligence to efficiency, which significantly impacts developers' daily iterations.

zh.thesis: Fast Company 报道了「新美学」艺术运动，将艺术家置于故事核心。
paragraphs: 这是一篇简短的推荐帖，作者 Tyler Cowen 称赞该报道让艺术家本人成为焦点。
